items.headline: South Carolina legend Alshon Jeffery discusses Georgia rivalry
items.description: Jeffery joins SEC Network's Marion Crowder on SEC Nation to preview the Gamecocks' matchup against the Bulldogs and explain how Shane Beamer recruited him to South Carolina.

items.headline: Saturday Spin: Manning's return to Texas, Stockton nation's best QB?
items.description: The SEC Nation crew spins the wheel and answers questions about what could be next for the conference's best quarterbacks.

items.headline: Which teams have the best odds to make the College Football Playoff?
items.description: We are tracking the odds for making the CFP, earning a bye and winning it all.

items.headline: Shane Beamer joins SEC Nation ahead of South Carolina vs. Georgia
items.description: Beamer joins the set from Columbia to preview the challenges Georgia presents for the Gamecocks and discuss how South Carolina can find success in the final stretch of the season.

items.headline: UGA's resilience, OU's efficiency highlight best of SEC Tournament first round
items.description: SEC Network's Mary Wise and Shelby Coppedge highlight Georgia's resilience and Oklahoma's efficiency as the top performances from the SEC Volleyball Tournament's opening round.

items.headline: No. 1 Georgia has all the tools to dismantle No. 21 South Carolina
items.description: The SEC Now crew breaks down what makes the Bulldogs elite and why their strengths position them to deliver a convincing road win over the Gamecocks.
